_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

body.en: This is the calmest stretch of the pregnancy and the best time to look at the numbers properly. Together, once, without panic. Doing it now means not doing it at 3am in month eight.
body.hi: Yeh pregnancy ka sabse shaant daur hai aur numbers ko theek se dekhne ka behtareen samay. Saath mein, ek baar, bina ghabraaye. Abhi karne ka matlab hai aathvein maheene ki raat teen baje na karna.
